description: Cases every implementation of nemar.sensor-layout.v1 reproduces. Each case gives positions (name, x, y, z in the frame coordinate_system names, or, for template positions that name a montage, in that montage's frame, RAS, with coordinate_system n/a; null is not finite; and sensor_type when the case has that column) and either the expected layout (center and center_method, montage or sphere, in the ALS frame, theta_deg and radius per row, null for a row that is not a scalp row or has no position: not finite, or exactly 0, 0, 0) or the word it is refused with. Template positions are centered on the montage's own center, its file's center; measured positions carry bounds, their singular_ratio, radius_ratio, dilution, stability, coverage and gap (null when not reached), which decide positions_flat against 0.05 and 3 and positions_partial against 4.5, 0.12, 38 degrees and 120 degrees, within tolerance.bounds_absolute. The expected theta and radius are eegprep's convertlocs(..., 'cart2topo') of the positions minus the center, with -180 written 180. frames lists the BIDS coordinate systems of each orientation: an implementation gives frame_als's layout for every ALS name and frame_ras's for every RAS name; aliases maps another spelling BIDS uses to the name it means, which an implementation reads in its place. cart2topo gives centered ALS points and the theta and radius each converts to, with no fit (theta within tolerance.cart2topo_theta_deg degrees, with no wrapping, and radius within tolerance.radius). Tolerances for the cases: radius within tolerance.radius; theta through the planar point (cos(theta) * radius, sin(theta) * radius), within tolerance.planar of the expected one, because theta is undefined at the pole; the center within tolerance.center_relative_to_scale times the largest distance of a finite position from their centroid.

cases.name: biosemi_128_ras
cases.description: eegprep's biosemi-128 cap in millimeters, x right, y anterior, z superior (CapTrak, an RAS frame).

cases.name: standard_10_5_als
cases.description: eegprep's 10-5 template (339 positions, fiducials removed) in meters, x anterior, y left, z superior (EEGLAB, an ALS frame).

cases.name: hydrocel_32_off_center
cases.description: eegprep's HydroCel 32 cap in centimeters (CapTrak), translated by (3, -1.5, 2): the sphere fit recovers the center.

cases.name: frame_ras
cases.description: Twelve HydroCel positions in an RAS frame; every RAS name gives this layout.

cases.name: frame_als
cases.description: The same twelve positions rotated into ALS; every ALS name gives this layout.

cases.name: ring_coplanar
cases.description: Nine positions on one circle, unevenly spaced and tilted 25 degrees: in one plane, so their singular ratio is 0 and they fix no head; refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: disk_flat
cases.description: Thirty-two positions scattered over a disk in the plane z = 0: refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: noisy_disk
cases.description: Forty-eight positions on a 9 cm disk with 0.09 mm of noise out of its plane, as a flat layout measured with noise: a sphere fitted to them would fit the noise; their singular ratio is 0.002, so refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: collinear_positions
cases.description: Five positions on one line: refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: nearly_collinear
cases.description: Five positions on one line but for 2.2e-12 off it at the middle one: refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: three_positions
cases.description: Three positions, which always lie in one plane: refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: coincident_positions
cases.description: Four positions at one point: refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: squashed_sphere_not_flat
cases.description: Sixty-four positions spread over a whole 9 cm sphere, squashed to 0.055 of its height: singular ratio 0.055, against the bound 0.05, with a sphere radius under 1 times their scale; the flatness bounds pass it, and the dilution (13) then refuses it (positions_partial): to its fitted center a squashed sphere is a ring, so no set this flat is drawn.

cases.name: squashed_sphere_outside
cases.description: Sixty-four positions spread over a whole 9 cm sphere, squashed to 0.045 of its height: singular ratio 0.045, against the bound 0.05, with a sphere radius under 1 times their scale; refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: cap_not_flat
cases.description: Positions on a 9 cm sphere within 21.0 degrees of its top: a shallow cap whose sphere radius is 2.8 times their scale, against the bound 3, with a singular ratio near 0.1; the flatness bounds pass it, and the dilution (52) then refuses it (positions_partial): a cap this shallow covers too little of a head to be drawn.

cases.name: cap_outside
cases.description: Positions on a 9 cm sphere within 19.0 degrees of its top: a shallow cap whose sphere radius is 3.1 times their scale, against the bound 3, with a singular ratio near 0.1; refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: measured_band_six
cases.description: Six measured positions, F3 F4 C3 C4 P3 P4 of eegprep's 10-5 template (EEGLAB, meters), and no others: they pass both flatness bounds (singular ratio 0.15, sphere radius 1.1 times their scale), but they cover a band across the top of the head, and their dilution (10.9) refuses them (positions_partial).

cases.name: measured_eight_no_midline
cases.description: Eight measured positions with no midline, the OpenBCI 8 set (Fp1 Fp2 C3 C4 P7 P8 O1 O2) of eegprep's 10-5 template: they span the whole head, low on every side, and are drawn about the sphere fitted to them.

cases.name: measured_sides_at_c3_c4
cases.description: Six measured positions of eegprep's 10-5 template, Fp1 Fp2 C3 C4 O1 O2, with no midline: the dilution and stability pass, and the front and back reach the equator, but on the left and right the lowest positions are C3 and C4, 42 degrees above it; refused (positions_partial, coverage).

cases.name: measured_midline_9
cases.description: Nine measured positions on the midline, Fpz to Oz, of eegprep's 10-5 template: they lie in one plane and fix no left or right, so refused (positions_flat); a renderer places them by name instead.

cases.name: missing_positions
cases.description: HydroCel 32 with row 5's y and all of row 20 not finite (written null): those rows get no layout and the fit uses the others.

cases.name: template_montage
cases.description: Template positions: every electrode of the montage GSN-HydroCel-32 (views/montages, RAS meters), with the coordinate system n/a. They are projected about the montage's own center, stored in its file.

cases.name: template_with_a_frame
cases.description: Template positions from a montage that also name a coordinate system (CapTrak) other than n/a: the frame is ambiguous, so refused.

cases.name: template_full_1005
cases.description: Template positions: every electrode of the montage standard_1005, with the coordinate system n/a. A subset is projected about the montage's own center, never a sphere fitted to the subset, so each electrode lands where template_full_1005 puts it.

cases.name: template_midline_9
cases.description: Template positions: the nine midline electrodes, Fpz to Oz, of the montage standard_1005, with the coordinate system n/a. A subset is projected about the montage's own center, never a sphere fitted to the subset, so each electrode lands where template_full_1005 puts it.

cases.name: template_coronal_9
cases.description: Template positions: the nine coronal electrodes, T7 to T8, of the montage standard_1005, with the coordinate system n/a. A subset is projected about the montage's own center, never a sphere fitted to the subset, so each electrode lands where template_full_1005 puts it.

cases.name: template_montage_wrong_case
cases.description: Template positions naming the montage GSN-HydroCel-32 in another case: montage names are matched exactly against the montage list, never through a file system that may fold case: refused (frame_unknown).

cases.name: template_montage_provenance
cases.description: Template positions naming the montage PROVENANCE, the name of the file beside the montages that records where they come from, which is not a montage: refused (frame_unknown).

cases.name: alias_MNI152NLin6ASym
cases.description: The coordinate-systems appendix's spelling 'MNI152NLin6ASym', read as the schema enum's 'MNI152NLin6Asym': an RAS frame, so frame_ras's layout.

cases.name: alias_MNI152NLin6ASym_lowercase
cases.description: 'mni152nlin6asym': names compare exactly, case included, and an alias too, so it is refused (frame_unknown).

cases.name: zero_rows
cases.description: eegprep's HydroCel 32 cap with rows 3 and 17 at exactly (0, 0, 0) and row 25 at (-0, 0, -0): a row at the frame's origin is a position the file does not have, so those rows get no layout and the sphere is fitted to the others.

cases.name: eog_and_neck_typed
cases.description: eegprep's HydroCel 32 cap typed EEG, three eye channels typed EOG at the canthi and below the left eye, and two neck muscle channels with no type (absent from channels.tsv), as OpenNeuro's emg_Multimodal example writes them: when any row is typed only the EEG rows are scalp rows, so the five get no layout and the center is the cap's (fitted to all 38 rows it would move 8.5% of the head radius).

cases.name: eog_and_neck_untyped
cases.description: The same 38 rows with no types, the five named EOG_R, EOG_L, EOG_V, EMG_neck_L and EMG_neck_R: with no row typed, a name that starts with a non-EEG prefix of nemar.sensor-labels.v1 is not a scalp row.

cases.name: fiducials_typed
cases.description: The 19 electrodes of the 10-20 system from the montage standard_1005 as measured positions (FieldTrip's 10-05 positions on the Colin27 head, MNIColin27, meters), with its nasion and preauricular points as rows Nz, LPA and RPA, typed EEG, the fiducials untyped, so only the EEG rows are scalp rows: the fiducials get no layout (fitted with them, the center would move 2% of the head radius).

cases.name: fiducials_untyped
cases.description: The 19 electrodes of the 10-20 system from the montage standard_1005 as measured positions (FieldTrip's 10-05 positions on the Colin27 head, MNIColin27, meters), with its nasion and preauricular points as rows Nz, LPA and RPA, with no types: a row named as a fiducial is never a scalp row: the fiducials get no layout (fitted with them, the center would move 2% of the head radius).

cases.name: flat_cap_with_fiducials
cases.description: The montage biosemi64 flattened to z = 0 (a two-dimensional layout written as three-dimensional positions) with its nasion and preauricular points at their true heights, named NAS, LPA and RPA (the vertex electrode lands on the origin, so it has no position): the fiducials are not scalp rows, so the flatness bound sees the flat cap alone and refuses it (positions_flat). Fitted with the fiducials it passed both flatness bounds.

cases.name: measured_ten_twenty
cases.description: Measured positions: from the montage standard_1005 (FieldTrip's 10-05 positions on the Colin27 head, MNIColin27, meters), the 19 electrodes of the 10-20 system: they cover the head (dilution 3.46; fit error 4.6% of the head radius); drawn.

cases.name: measured_emotiv_14
cases.description: Measured positions: from the montage standard_1005 (FieldTrip's 10-05 positions on the Colin27 head, MNIColin27, meters), the 14 electrodes of the Emotiv EPOC, a ring around the head with no top (dilution 5.96; fit error 10.0% of the head radius); refused (positions_partial).

cases.name: measured_frontal_6
cases.description: Measured positions: from the montage standard_1005 (FieldTrip's 10-05 positions on the Colin27 head, MNIColin27, meters), six frontal electrodes (dilution 8.02; fit error 30.1% of the head radius); refused (positions_partial).

cases.name: measured_central_9
cases.description: Measured positions: from the montage standard_1005 (FieldTrip's 10-05 positions on the Colin27 head, MNIColin27, meters), nine central electrodes around the vertex (dilution 5.99; fit error 14.8% of the head radius); refused (positions_partial).

cases.name: stability_inside
cases.description: The 19 electrodes of the 10-20 system on the Colin27 head (MNIColin27), with Cz digitized 28.75% too far from the montage's center: the dilution passes, and leaving Cz out moves the fitted center by 0.114, less than 0.12 of the radius; drawn.

cases.name: stability_outside
cases.description: The 19 electrodes of the 10-20 system on the Colin27 head (MNIColin27), with Cz digitized 31% too far from the montage's center: the dilution passes, and leaving Cz out moves the fitted center by 0.125, more than 0.12 of the radius; refused (positions_partial).

cases.name: p300_8_noisy_unstable
cases.description: The posterior P300 set (Fz, Cz, Pz, P3, P4, PO7, PO8, Oz) of the Colin27 head measured with 5 mm of noise: the noise spreads the directions so the dilution passes (4.28), but leaving one position out moves the center by 0.19 of the radius; refused (positions_partial).

cases.name: mi_16_noisy_low_coverage
cases.description: Measured positions of the Colin27 head (MNIColin27): 16 motor-imagery electrodes measured with 8 mm of noise: the noise bends them onto a smaller sphere, so the dilution (4.20) and stability (0.07) pass, but the front's lowest position is 39.7 degrees above the fitted equator; refused (positions_partial, coverage).

cases.name: p300_8_noisy_gap
cases.description: Measured positions of the Colin27 head (MNIColin27): the P300 set measured with 5 mm of noise: the dilution, stability and coverage pass, but nothing lies between Fz and the parietal row, 125 degrees apart in azimuth; refused (positions_partial, gap).

cases.name: measured_psg_8
cases.description: Measured positions of the Colin27 head (MNIColin27): a sleep montage, F3 F4 C3 C4 O1 O2 with the mastoids M1 and M2: the front's lowest positions, F3 and F4, are 33 degrees above the fitted equator and every other side reaches below it; drawn.

cases.name: measured_openbci_8
cases.description: Measured positions of the Colin27 head (MNIColin27): the OpenBCI 8 set, Fp1 Fp2 C3 C4 P7 P8 O1 O2: low on every side; drawn.

cases.name: coverage_inside
cases.description: Positions evenly over a 9 cm sphere down to 25 degrees below its equator, with the front quadrant emptied below 40 degrees and one position straight ahead at 37: every other side reaches below the equator, so the coverage is 37, against the bound 38; drawn.

cases.name: coverage_outside
cases.description: Positions evenly over a 9 cm sphere down to 25 degrees below its equator, with the front quadrant emptied below 42 degrees and one position straight ahead at 39: every other side reaches below the equator, so the coverage is 39, against the bound 38; refused (positions_partial).

cases.name: gap_inside
cases.description: The same cover with every position emptied from a wedge of azimuth 75.5 to 194.5 degrees, across the left and back quadrants, and one position at each of its edges, 5 degrees below the equator: two neighbors 119 degrees apart, against the bound 120, while every quadrant still reaches below the equator; drawn.

cases.name: gap_outside
cases.description: The same cover with every position emptied from a wedge of azimuth 74.5 to 195.5 degrees, across the left and back quadrants, and one position at each of its edges, 5 degrees below the equator: two neighbors 121 degrees apart, against the bound 120, while every quadrant still reaches below the equator; refused (positions_partial).

cases.name: central_9_with_egi_fiducials
cases.description: A regional set of the Colin27 head with the nasion and preauricular points as rows named FidNz, FidT9, FidT10: fiducials are not scalp rows, so the set alone is fitted and refused (positions_partial); counted, the fiducials would let it pass.

cases.name: p300_8_with_eeglab_fiducials
cases.description: A regional set of the Colin27 head with the nasion and preauricular points as rows named Nasion, LeftEar, RightEar: fiducials are not scalp rows, so the set alone is fitted and refused (positions_partial); counted, the fiducials would let it pass.

cases.name: cap_partial_inside
cases.description: Positions on a 9 cm sphere within 88.0 degrees of its top, an even cover of a little more than a hemisphere: dilution 4.36, against the bound 4.5; drawn.

cases.name: cap_partial_outside
cases.description: Positions on a 9 cm sphere within 84.0 degrees of its top, an even cover of a little less than a hemisphere: dilution 4.62, against the bound 4.5; refused (positions_partial).
